verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own site says you can 'run Ubuntu alongside' Windows instead of replacing it. The docs cover installation and topics specific to coexisting with Windows: handling BitLocker during installation, Intel RST, and switching Windows to AHCI. Missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step dual-boot/partitioning guide in the evidence, bootloader/OS-selection details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of dual-boot installs.
